name: rohan-portfolio
description: Explorable 3D portfolio for Md. Sakibul Hasan Rohan

comments.overrides: ecctrl imports QueryFilterFlags straight from @dimforge/rapier3d-compat without declaring it, and npm resolves that to the 0.12 copy dragged in by @types/three. The physics world is built by @react-three/rapier against 0.19, so ecctrl ends up talking to a second, uninitialised WASM instance: its ground raycasts silently fail and the character never walks. Pinning one version keeps a single instance.
